curation.lead:
Edward Coristine (born December 2005), known online as "Big Balls" and by the alias "Rivage," is a Connecticut-based technologist who, at age 19, was appointed as a Special Government Employee within the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) in January 2025 and subsequently deployed with system access credentials across at least nine federal agencies: OPM, CISA, State Department, DHS, FEMA, GSA, HHS, USAID, and the Department of Education [Finding #5959]. At CISA, the federal agency responsible for protecting critical national cyber infrastructure, and at the Department of Education, he had access to databases containing Social Security numbers and bank records of an estimated 43 million student loan borrowers — data that was subsequently fed into Azure AI systems [Finding #5959]. His GSA clearance was classified at the A-suite level, granting access to all physical spaces and IT systems [Finding #5959]. He filed no financial disclosure through ProPublica's DOGE tracker and made no FEC political donations [Finding #5959].

Prior to his government appointment, Coristine was fired at age 17 from a cybersecurity internship at Path Network in June 2022 for leaking proprietary information to competitors; an executive message confirmed "Edward has been terminated for leaking internal information to the competitors" [Finding #6456]. Within two months of that termination, Coristine posted in a Discord channel under his alias "Rivage" that he had retained unauthorized access to Path Network systems for months after his firing [Finding #6456]. Between October 2022 and June 2023, his Connecticut-registered company DiamondCDN LLC (registered August 23, 2022 at 26 Lakeview Ave, New Canaan, CT) provided CDN and DDoS-protection services to EGodly, a cybercrime group that publicly boasted about hijacking phone numbers, trafficking stolen personally identifiable information, hacking law enforcement email accounts, and cyberstalking an FBI agent in Wilmington, Delaware — distributing his home address and photographs [Finding #6452]. In November 2022, Coristine was tracked by law enforcement under the alias "JoeyCrafter" for soliciting DDoS-for-hire services in the Dstat Discord channel [Finding #6430].

Coristine graduated from Rye Country Day School in 2024 and briefly attended Northeastern University before leaving in spring 2025 to join DOGE [Finding #5959]. He reported to Aram Moghaddassi during a subsequent assignment to the Social Security Administration beginning June 2025, where Moghaddassi as SSA CIO granted Coristine and others access to USCIS immigration databases [Connection #3257]. He resigned from DOGE in late June 2025 following Elon Musk's own departure from the advisory role, then transitioned to the National Design Studio under Joe Gebbia by December 2025, where he was credited with building websites and branding for the Trump administration's "Genesis" AI initiative as part of a three-person team [Finding #6458]. His maternal grandfather, Valery Martynov, was a Soviet KGB officer in the Line X technical espionage division who became a CIA/FBI double agent codenamed "Gentile" in 1982; Martynov was betrayed by CIA officer Aldrich Ames and executed by the KGB on May 28, 1987 [Finding #6454].
curation.system_role: Coristine's trajectory documents how DOGE's vetting process enabled an individual with a documented history of unauthorized data access and connections to cybercrime infrastructure to receive simultaneous, unrestricted credentials across the most sensitive federal cybersecurity and data systems, bypassing the standard background checks that exist specifically to screen for such histories.

sections.title: Federal Access Profile
sections.content:
Coristine held concurrent access credentials across at least nine federal agencies as a DOGE "Expert" without undergoing the standard background check process that would have surfaced his firing from Path Network and his documented associations with cybercrime infrastructure [Finding #5959]. His GSA clearance was at the A-suite tier, granting access to all physical spaces and IT systems across that agency, while at CISA he held a DHS email address and network access [Finding #5959]. The breadth of simultaneous access — OPM, CISA, State Department, DHS, FEMA, GSA, HHS, USAID, and the Department of Education — is documented in ProPublica's DOGE tracker, which also notes that Coristine filed no financial disclosure at any point during his government service [Finding #5959].

At the Department of Education, DOGE personnel including Coristine accessed databases containing Social Security numbers and bank account records for approximately 43 million student loan borrowers; that data was subsequently routed into Microsoft Azure AI systems [Finding #5959]. Federal court filings addressed the Education Department access specifically [Finding #5959]. The Senate HSGAC report authored by Senator Peters (September 2025) identified Coristine by name as an example of a DOGE staffer with a documented data-mishandling history who nonetheless received unrestricted access to SSA systems when he transitioned there in June 2025 [Finding #6402].

At OPM, Coristine reported to Aram Moghaddassi's chain of command through Amanda Scales, the OPM Chief of Staff and former xAI employee [Finding #6430]. At the SSA, Moghaddassi — serving as CIO — granted Coristine and other DOGE-affiliated personnel access to USCIS immigration databases [Connection #3257]. Coristine's tenure as a full-time government employee began in May 2025 and his formal SSA assignment commenced June 2025 [Finding #6402].

sections.title: Cybercrime Associations and Prior Conduct
sections.content:
Path Network CEO Marshal Webb had internally advocated against firing Coristine from his cybersecurity internship, reasoning that doing so would make him "an enemy" [Finding #6456]. The June 2022 termination proceeded regardless, with an executive confirming in writing that Coristine had been "terminated for leaking internal information to the competitors" [Finding #6456]. Within two months of the termination, Coristine posted in a Discord channel under the alias "Rivage" that he had retained access to Path Network's game-hosting machines for months after being let go [Finding #6456]. A large collection of internal Path Network documents was subsequently leaked online [Finding #6456].

On August 23, 2022 — approximately two months after the Path Network firing — Coristine registered DiamondCDN LLC at 26 Lakeview Ave, New Canaan, Connecticut [Finding #6452]. From October 2022 through June 2023, DiamondCDN provided CDN hosting and DDoS-protection infrastructure to EGodly, a cybercrime group that publicly claimed responsibility for phone number hijacking, trafficking stolen PII, hacking law enforcement email accounts, and an extended harassment campaign against an FBI agent in Wilmington, Delaware that included distributing his home address, posting photographs of his residence, and conducting physical surveillance drive-bys [Finding #6452]. EGodly publicly thanked DiamondCDN on Telegram on February 15, 2023 [Finding #6452]. KrebsOnSecurity documented Coristine's EGodly associations in its "The Com" reporting series [Finding #6452].

In November 2022, law enforcement tracked Coristine under the alias "JoeyCrafter" for soliciting DDoS-for-hire services in the Dstat Discord channel [Finding #6430]. Coristine's three Connecticut LLCs — DiamondCDN LLC, MISTDECK LLC, and Tesla.Sexy LLC — were registered during this same period [Finding #6430]. Tesla.Sexy LLC, registered in 2021 when Coristine was approximately 16, controls dozens of web domains including at least two Russian-registered domains; one active Russian domain operates an AI-powered Discord bot called "Helfie" targeting the Russian market [Finding #6457]. A Discord server associated with Tesla.Sexy LLC contains audio from November 6, 2021 of members conducting doxing and harassment operations, with references to membership in hacker communities Anonymous and Verm Squad [Finding #6457]. Of the three Connecticut companies, Tesla.Sexy LLC is the only one still listed as active [Finding #6457].

sections.title: Network and Career Trajectory
sections.content:
Coristine's entry into government came through the Musk network. Before DOGE, he held an internship at Neuralink, the Musk-controlled neurotechnology company [Connection #3008]. At OPM, he reported up through Amanda Scales — a former xAI employee installed as OPM Chief of Staff — and was professionally connected to Elon Musk through DOGE's operational chain [Finding #6430]. The Revolving Door Project and LittleSis both document Coristine's placement as a DOGE Expert [Connection #3252]. He transitioned to SSA in June 2025 under Aram Moghaddassi, described in an SSA CDO whistleblower complaint as a longtime Musk ally [Connection #3257].

Coristine resigned from DOGE in late June 2025, after Musk's own departure from the initiative in late May 2025, according to contemporaneous news accounts [Finding #5813]. He then moved to the National Design Studio, a White House design unit led by Joe Gebbia — the Airbnb co-founder who simultaneously held a Tesla board seat and audit committee position while working in DOGE [Connection #3258]. Reuters confirmed Coristine's presence at the National Design Studio; he was credited with building the websites and brand identity for the Trump administration's "Genesis" AI initiative as part of a three-person team [Finding #6458].

On August 3, 2025, Coristine was beaten in a carjacking attempt in Washington, D.C. [Finding #6458]. The incident subsequently became a stated justification for a Trump administration law-enforcement surge in the District [Finding #6458]. No financial disclosure was filed by Coristine through ProPublica's DOGE tracker at any point during his government service [Finding #5959].

sections.title: Family Intelligence Background
sections.content:
Coristine's maternal grandfather, Valery Martynov, was assigned to Line X — the KGB's technical espionage division responsible for acquiring Western scientific and technological secrets — and stationed in Washington, D.C. [Finding #6454]. Beginning in 1982, Martynov operated as a double agent for the CIA and FBI under the codename "Gentile" [Finding #6454]. His identity as a Western asset was compromised by CIA officer Aldrich Ames, who sold Soviet intelligence to the KGB; Martynov was recalled to Moscow on a pretext, arrested, and executed on May 28, 1987 [Finding #6454].

Martynov's daughter Anna — Coristine's mother — subsequently became a financial professional and married Charles Coristine, owner of the LesserEvil snack company [Finding #6454]. Edward Coristine was raised in New Canaan, Connecticut, attended Rye Country Day School (graduating 2024), and briefly enrolled at Northeastern University before leaving in spring 2025 [Finding #5959]. This family background is relevant in the security clearance context: Coristine received unrestricted federal system access across multiple agencies without the standard background investigation process that would have evaluated both his family history and his documented 2022 cybercrime associations [Finding #6454].

sections.title: Connecticut Corporate Entities
sections.content:
Coristine registered three limited liability companies in Connecticut: Tesla.Sexy LLC, founded approximately 2021 when he was around 16 years old; DiamondCDN LLC, registered August 23, 2022 at 26 Lakeview Ave, New Canaan, CT; and MISTDECK LLC [Finding #6457, Finding #6430]. Tesla.Sexy LLC is the only entity still listed as active and controls a portfolio of web domains, including Russian-registered domains hosting the "Helfie" AI Discord bot targeting the Russian market [Finding #6457]. MISTDECK LLC's operational purpose has not been established in the available record.

DiamondCDN LLC served as the corporate vehicle through which Coristine provided CDN infrastructure and DDoS protection to the EGodly cybercrime group from October 2022 through June 2023 [Finding #6452]. The timing of DiamondCDN's registration — two months after the Path Network firing — is consistent with the period in which Coristine was also posting in Discord about maintaining unauthorized access to Path Network systems [Finding #6456]. The EGodly association documented in Reuters and KrebsOnSecurity reporting represents the clearest documented corporate link between Coristine's entity structure and cybercriminal infrastructure [Finding #6452].

open_questions: What specific background check process, if any, was applied before granting Coristine simultaneous A-suite GSA clearance and CISA network access, and which officials authorized those access grants given the documented Path Network and EGodly record?

What actions did Coristine take with Education Department student loan borrower data (43 million SSNs and bank records) after it was routed to Azure AI systems, and what data governance controls, if any, were applied?

What is the current operational status of the two Russian-registered domains controlled by Tesla.Sexy LLC and the Helfie Discord bot, including the corporate registration details of those Russian domain registrants?
Did MISTDECK LLC conduct any operational activity, and does it share officers, addresses, or clients with DiamondCDN LLC or Tesla.Sexy LLC?

What is the scope of the National Design Studio's work on the 'Genesis' AI initiative, which federal agencies or data systems it interfaces with, and whether Coristine's access profile there was subject to the same vetting gaps as his DOGE deployment?
